items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1960-11-30
items.q: he had me to go play some nights for him... I stayed there

ctx.x: I just thought this was interesting.

Paul Barnes. He was fast on his life, wasn't he? Did you ever play with Paul? No, in later years. So then, just after he started in his Dixieland music, whenever he worked as a big band, never played one job with him in a big band. See, when he went to Petter, the job was getting kind of rough for him. He wanted to lay off some nights, so he had me to go play some nights for him. So he asked me to stay on it until he come back, but he wasn't particular about coming back, you see? So I stayed there. And it was…
